rationale: Announcement Banners is a brand-new, cross-cutting surface (a Settings > General authoring drawer + a banner strip rendered in MainLayout's header on every page). No existing spec covers it: a grep for 'announcement' across tests/ui-testing returned nothing, and the closest siblings (theme-management, logoManagement, edition-features) exercise unrelated settings surfaces. The feature spans a new settings entry point, a new drawer/dialog/card, and a global header strip — it does not naturally append to any existing spec. Target folder is GeneralTests (matches run-context spec_path and the existing cross-cutting specs like logoManagement/theme-management/languageTranslation). needs_registration=true: the new spec must be added to the GeneralTests shard's run_files in tests/ui-testing/ci-matrix/ci_matrix.json (the single source of truth shared with ENT; the matrix is generated by build-ci-matrix.js, not hand-edited into playwright.yml).
